text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Newspapers (Permit) Regulations. Application for permit.
Every application for a permit under the Act shall be made in such form as the Minister may determine. Form of permit.

The permit granted under the Act shall be in the form prescribed in the Schedule. 4 CAP. 105, Rg 2 Newspapers

SCHEDULE Serial No. (regulation 3)

NEWSPAPERS ACT (Chapter 105) NEWSPAPERS (PERMIT) REGULATIONS

PERMIT TO PRINT, PUBLISH, SELL OR DISTRIBUTE NEWSPAPER In exercise of the power conferred by section 3, the Minister of Home Affairs hereby grants a permit to the person named below for the printing*, publication, sale and distribution within Brunei Darussalam of the newspaper described below, subject to the conditions on the reverse of this permit. Name and address of permit holder Name and address of agent in Brunei Darussalam [for an overseas newspaper] Name of newspaper Nature of contents Place at which printed Language in which printed Date of issue Date of expiry .......................................................... Minister of Home Affairs Reference: * Delete the word “printing” in the case of an overseas newspaper.

CONDITIONS
